payload.body: GO for releasing.md step 2: every sweep bank is on main, and the final code HEAD is fa33491e2. Ask devbin-vc for one cargo slot for bin/devbin build all at main's HEAD, and for what the shots need. Take the shots with gen_explorer_shots.sh with that pair first on PATH, judge each PNG with magick compare -metric AE -fuzz 10%, and bank the changed ones at refs/bank/ic/precut354/. Send cc the pair's version and sha for the known-defects re-drive as soon as build all is green. Report to vc: the pair's stamp, the shots' verdicts, and the bank.
